authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9875.2 *maricca gives Punjabi miric/marc and red-pepper forms, plus Bhojpuri maricā chillies. Goj meric fits this retained-affricate regional pepper family. Rana mitʃi is compared with mircī with r loss retained as a regional phonetic qualification; section 1 marīca instead gives forms lacking the affricate. Exact survey form mitʃi is preserved.
